tools.name: place_cube
tools.title: Place Cube
tools.description: Places one or more Cubes. Every new Cube must provide explicit finite from/to geometry extents; place_cube does not create a default [0,0,0]→[1,1,1] Cube when geometry was omitted. Unrotated Cubes may omit origin and use the neutral [0,0,0] value; any Cube with non-zero rotation must provide an explicit origin/pivot so a missing pivot cannot silently become [0,0,0]. If `group` is omitted or explicitly `root`, placement is at root. Any other supplied group must resolve by exact UUID or exact unique name before mutation; missing or ambiguous groups fail instead of silently falling back to root. If `texture` is omitted, existing default-texture behavior is preserved. A supplied texture resolves exact UUID first, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique; ambiguous or missing references fail before Undo/Cube creation.

origin.description: Intentional Cube pivot/origin. May be omitted for an unrotated Cube. A Cube with any non-zero rotation must provide origin explicitly.
origin.markdownDescription: Intentional Cube pivot/origin. May be omitted for an unrotated Cube. A Cube with any non-zero rotation must provide origin explicitly.

from.description: Explicit authored Cube start coordinates. Required for initial placement; place_cube never supplies a default geometry extent.
from.markdownDescription: Explicit authored Cube start coordinates. Required for initial placement; place_cube never supplies a default geometry extent.

to.description: Explicit authored Cube end coordinates. Required for initial placement; place_cube never supplies a default geometry extent.
to.markdownDescription: Explicit authored Cube end coordinates. Required for initial placement; place_cube never supplies a default geometry extent.

rotation.description: Cube rotation in degrees. Non-zero rotation requires an explicit evidence-backed origin/pivot.
rotation.markdownDescription: Cube rotation in degrees. Non-zero rotation requires an explicit evidence-backed origin/pivot.

elements.description: Array of Cubes to place. Every Cube requires explicit finite from/to extents. Unrotated Cubes may omit origin; every Cube with non-zero rotation must provide an explicit origin/pivot.
elements.markdownDescription: Array of Cubes to place. Every Cube requires explicit finite from/to extents. Unrotated Cubes may omit origin; every Cube with non-zero rotation must provide an explicit origin/pivot.

texture.description: Optional texture reference. Omit to keep the existing default-texture behavior. When supplied, UUID is preferred, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique; ambiguous or missing references are rejected before Cube creation.
texture.markdownDescription: Optional texture reference. Omit to keep the existing default-texture behavior. When supplied, UUID is preferred, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique; ambiguous or missing references are rejected before Cube creation.

group.description: Exact Group UUID or exact unique name. Omit this field (or pass `root`) only when root placement is intentional.
group.markdownDescription: Exact Group UUID or exact unique name. Omit this field (or pass `root`) only when root placement is intentional.

anyOf.markdownDescription: Array of faces to apply the texture to.

anyOf.markdownDescription: Whether to apply the texture to all faces. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

face.markdownDescription: Face to apply the texture to.

uv.markdownDescription: Custom UV mapping for the face.

faces.markdownDescription: Faces to apply the texture to. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

tools.name: modify_cube
tools.title: Modify Cube
tools.description: Modifies one explicit Cube target. `id` is required: UUID is resolved first, otherwise an exact name must be unique; editor selection is never used as an implicit mutation target. Ambiguous names fail instead of modifying multiple Cubes. An origin-only transform change uses Blockbench Cube.transferOrigin so pivot movement preserves visual position; origin combined with from/to/rotation is treated as an authored geometry rewrite. Activating non-zero rotation on a currently unrotated Cube requires explicit origin in the same request; later rotation adjustments may reuse the existing pivot. Auto UV setting: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

id.description: Required Cube target: exact UUID or exact unique name. UUID is preferred. Editor selection is not used as an implicit mutation target.
id.markdownDescription: Required Cube target: exact UUID or exact unique name. UUID is preferred. Editor selection is not used as an implicit mutation target.

origin.description: Cube pivot/origin. If supplied without from/to/rotation, this is a pivot-only correction and visual position is preserved. If combined with from/to/rotation, origin is applied as part of the authored geometry rewrite.
origin.markdownDescription: Cube pivot/origin. If supplied without from/to/rotation, this is a pivot-only correction and visual position is preserved. If combined with from/to/rotation, origin is applied as part of the authored geometry rewrite.

rotation.description: Rotation of the Cube. If the target is currently unrotated and this activates a non-zero rotation, provide origin explicitly in the same request. Later rotation adjustments on an already-rotated Cube may reuse its existing pivot.
rotation.markdownDescription: Rotation of the Cube. If the target is currently unrotated and this activates a non-zero rotation, provide origin explicitly in the same request. Later rotation adjustments on an already-rotated Cube may reuse its existing pivot.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.
autouv.markdownDescription: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube.
shade.markdownDescription: Whether to apply shading to the cube.

color.description: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.
color.markdownDescription: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.
visibility.markdownDescription: Whether the cube is visible or not.

tools.name: modify_cubes_batch
tools.title: Modify Cubes Batch
tools.description: Applies one coherent correction across several explicitly identified Cubes in a single recoverable Undo unit. Every target must be an exact Cube UUID and all targets are preflighted before mutation. Each Cube may receive different from/to/origin/rotation/visibility values. Per update, origin without from/to/rotation is a pivot-only transfer that preserves visual position; origin combined with geometry transform fields is an authored rewrite. Activating non-zero rotation on a currently unrotated target requires explicit origin in that update; already-rotated targets may adjust rotation while reusing their existing pivots. If any target fails preflight, the batch does not open Undo. If mutation fails after Undo starts, the edit is cancelled with changes reverted. This tool performs no visual judgement, planning, reparenting, UV work, or automatic correction.

id.description: Exact Cube UUID. Names and selection are intentionally unsupported so a multi-Cube correction cannot silently target the wrong element.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Cube UUID. Names and selection are intentionally unsupported so a multi-Cube correction cannot silently target the wrong element.

origin.description: New Cube pivot/origin. When origin is the only transform field in this update, the tool treats it as a pivot-only correction and preserves the Cube's visual position. When combined with from/to/rotation, it is treated as part of an authored geometry rewrite.
origin.markdownDescription: New Cube pivot/origin. When origin is the only transform field in this update, the tool treats it as a pivot-only correction and preserves the Cube's visual position. When combined with from/to/rotation, it is treated as part of an authored geometry rewrite.

rotation.description: New authored Cube rotation in degrees. If the target Cube is currently unrotated and this activates a non-zero rotation, origin must be supplied explicitly in the same update. A Cube that is already rotated may adjust rotation while reusing its existing pivot.
rotation.markdownDescription: New authored Cube rotation in degrees. If the target Cube is currently unrotated and this activates a non-zero rotation, origin must be supplied explicitly in the same update. A Cube that is already rotated may adjust rotation while reusing its existing pivot.

updates.description: One to 32 explicit per-Cube authored transform/visibility updates applied as one recoverable Undo unit.
updates.markdownDescription: One to 32 explicit per-Cube authored transform/visibility updates applied as one recoverable Undo unit.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns information about textures. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `textures://skin`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, slug, or short numeric texture id.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models in the current project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `reference_models://turntable`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns current validation warnings. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns current validation errors. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.
